description: The chart illustrates the performance of various reinforcement learning (RL) methods, with and without self-reflection, across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, marked at intervals of 2. Each category is associated with a group of six bars, representing different RL methods: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (salmon), GRPO (orange), PPO+Self-reflection (green), and PPO (teal). For Mathverse, the bars have approximate accuracy values of 56.2, 53, 55.8, 53.4, 54.6, and 53.4, respectively. For MMLU, the bars have approximate accuracy values of 56.8, 55.8, 57, 55.8, 56, and 54.8, respectively. For Physics, the bars have approximate accuracy values of 61, 58, 60.6, 58.2, 59, and 56.8, respectively. The bars within each category are grouped together, with distinct colors representing different RL methods, but are not sorted in any particular order. No bars are visually emphasized.
